spans.s:
अभ्व अ-भ्व, अस्, आ, अम् (etymology doubt-
ful, भ्व = भव or भुव?), Ved. huge, immense,
mighty; monstrous, terrible; (अस्), m. a powerful
man, applied to an enemy; (अम्), n. immense power,
monstrosity, the great pervading principle of the uni-
verse; embarrassed state, great calamity; sultriness (?);
a monster; offspring; water, a cloud.
